description: This file is a server-side PHP script that handles saving and updating email marketing campaign data within SuiteCRM. It processes form submissions, manages campaign record retrieval and updates, user access permissions, and associations with prospect lists. Additionally, it performs redirection and JSON responses for AJAX requests related to marketing campaign updates.

classes.name: Bean
classes.description: A class representing CRM beans, used for retrieving and saving email marketing records.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the EmailMarketing bean object, with optional notification check.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves an existing EmailMarketing record by ID.

methods.name: load_relationship
methods.description: Loads a specified relationship, e.g., prospect lists.
